people.seed: Ria, a tram driver in her late fifties, thirty-one years on the job, born in the Jordaan, shop steward at the tram depot in Amsterdam-West. Bilal and Gerrit work at the same depot.
Bilal, a junior tram dispatcher in his late twenties at the tram depot in Amsterdam-West, Moroccan-Dutch, from Slotervaart, still lives close to his parents. Ria and Gerrit work at the same depot.
Gerrit, a rolling-stock mechanic in his early sixties at the tram depot in Amsterdam-West, counting the months to his pension. Ria and Bilal work at the same depot.

relations: you've worked out of the same depot for over twenty years

people.seed: Sharda Ramdin, sixty-three, Hindustani-Surinamese, came to the Netherlands as a teenager, owns and runs Roti Ramdin, a small takeaway in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Her son Dinesh works there with her, and Kwame helps at the counter.
Dinesh Ramdin, thirty-six, Sharda's son, came back to work in her takeaway Roti Ramdin in Amsterdam-Zuidoost after a logistics job ended. Divorced, sees his daughter on fixed days.
Kwame, nineteen, Ghanaian-Dutch, grew up in the Bijlmer, works the counter at Roti Ramdin in Amsterdam-Zuidoost while he saves money and works out what comes next. Sharda and Dinesh are his bosses.

relations: you're mother and son, and you run the takeaway together
you work together at the takeaway; you've known each other a year

people.seed: Ines, twenty-one, from Porto, studies Japanese Studies in Amsterdam and shares a student house in Watergraafsmeer with Mees and Tobias. She helps out at a small Shinto shrine on Saturdays, for her thesis. She doesn't know anyone there well yet.
Mees, twenty, dropped out of a law degree and works as a bike courier all over Amsterdam, shares a student house in Watergraafsmeer with Ines and Tobias.
Tobias, twenty-four, German, a medical student in Amsterdam on clinical rotations, shares a student house in Watergraafsmeer with Ines and Mees.
Hiske, forty-seven, Frisian, a care aide at De Vlinderhof, a care home in Amsterdam-Noord. Cor and Annie are residents she looks after.
Cor, eighty-four, retired shipyard welder from Noord, widower, lives in a room at De Vlinderhof care home in Amsterdam-Noord. Annie lives down the corridor, Hiske is one of the aides.
Annie, eighty-one, retired primary-school teacher, widow, lives in a room at De Vlinderhof care home in Amsterdam-Noord. Cor lives down the corridor, Hiske is one of the aides.

relations: you know each other from the care home, where she's an aide and he lives
